## Work Order Workbench

The operator's single-work-order execution surface: identity + status header, the Checklist Runner, labour and parts logged as the job goes, a downtime summary, and the action buttons for the job's own state machine (Start / Hold / Resume / Complete). This component owns no Command — every action is a callback the host wires to the real Command, so it stays reusable for any job-execution UI.

Mounted two ways: inline in a host's work-order list, and inside `WorkOrder`'s own isolated component, so opening a Work Order via `viewCard` from anywhere (the calendar popover, the board, a search result) IS the full technician workbench, never a read-only summary. `WorkOrder` supplies its own live Spare Part query and its own Start/Hold/Resume/Complete methods (calling the same commands) so the card works fully standalone.
